entities.name: PMID:25444850
observations: 2015 goat AF-persistence study used serial right-atrial epicardial mapping, Cx40/Cx43 immunodetection, and connective-tissue quantification.

entities.name: AF fractionation mechanism
observations: During AF progression in goats, fractionated electrograms co-localized with slow conduction/block and were associated with increased Cx40 heterogeneity and Cx43 lateralization; connective-tissue content and net conduction velocity did not change.
